risk_if_not_implemented: Without Data Shelf-Life Classification for Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC) Prioritization, cryptographic protections may be inadequate or quantum-vulnerable, risking future decryption of currently protected data.

compensating_control_1.name: Data & Asset Classification
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to ensure data and assets are categorized in accordance with applicable statutory, regulatory and contractual requirements.
compensating_control_1.justification: Data & Asset Classification (DCH-02) provides asset and inventory visibility that compensates for the absence of Data Shelf-Life Classification for Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC) Prioritization (QTS-01.2) by providing the foundational asset knowledge needed to manage risks associated with the primary control. Given the data-handling focus of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Risk Ranking
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to identify and assign a risk ranking to newly discovered security vulnerabilities that is based on industry-recognized practices.
compensating_control_2.justification: Risk Ranking (RSK-05) provides risk identification and prioritization that compensates for the absence of Data Shelf-Life Classification for Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC) Prioritization (QTS-01.2) by enabling informed decisions about where to focus resources to manage residual exposure. Given the data-handling focus of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
